profiles.deleteImpact: Delete this profile? Its assignments to {devices} devices and {sites} sites will be cleared; affected displays then inherit the workspace defaults.
profiles.defaultHint: New displays and displays without a profile use “{name}”.
profiles.noDefaultHint: No default set — displays without a profile use the built-in intervals (60 s on USB, 15 min on battery).
profiles.whileWaitingHint: Enrolled displays with nothing assigned check back this often, so assigning content during setup takes effect promptly. It only ever shortens the intervals above; displays on a critical battery keep their low-battery interval.
profiles.conflict: This profile was changed by someone else. Reload before applying your changes.
profiles.defaultFailed: Failed to set the default profile
profiles.emptyDescription: Create profiles to control how often displays refresh.
profiles.errorRetryHint: How long a display waits after a failed refresh. Each failure advances one step and the last step is held. Keep the first step well below the refresh interval for quick recovery. Remove all steps to retain the normal interval after errors.
profiles.scheduleHint: Set refresh, brightness and power behaviour for USB and battery operation in one phase. The first matching rule wins.
profiles.noScheduleRules: No schedule rules. Add a template above or the default intervals will be used around the clock.
profiles.saveImpact: Saving changes the policy for {devices} directly assigned devices and {sites} sites on their next poll. The complete before/after change is written to the audit log.
profiles.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, for example Europe/Berlin.
profiles.capabilityHint: Vellum adapts the result to each display: e-paper retains its image without panel power and sleeps between battery polls; LCD devices can switch the panel off while remaining reachable on USB power.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.defaultHint: Defaults outside scheduled phases. Phase-specific brightness is configured directly in each phase above.
brightness.hint: Only displays that report a backlight. Rules use the same days and hours as above; the first match wins.
brightness.noRules: No dimming rules. The values above apply all day.

phase.sleepHint: LCD panel power is removed before the pause. E-paper keeps its last image without power. A timer or the green button resumes the device.

profiles.scopeHint: Refresh cadence, brightness, display power and sleep behaviour for a group of displays.

system.serverUpdaterNotConfigured: The update service is not configured for this Vellum installation.

system.serverUpdaterInvalidResponse: The update service returned an invalid response.
system.serverUpdaterInvalidHint: Vellum reached the update service, but could not validate its response. Check that the server and updater use compatible versions and credentials.
system.serverUpdaterSetupHint: Check the Compose stack on the host. If an existing installation does not include the update service, an administrator must add it there once. The guide also covers configuration and connectivity failures.
system.serverUpdaterSetupLink: Open the guide for existing installations
system.serverAutoUpdateOn: Up to date. New stable releases are installed automatically.
system.serverUpToDate: The server is up to date.

system.serverManualSchedule: Up to date. Installation requires confirmation.
system.serverScheduleFailed: Update behavior could not be saved
system.serverConfirmMessage: Version {version} will be verified and installed. The console may be unavailable briefly; an unhealthy deployment is rolled back automatically.
system.serverActionForbidden: This action is not allowed. Reload the page or check your permission.
system.serverUpdateFailedGeneric: The update service could not complete the operation.
system.serverReleasePreparing: Release {version} is still being published as a signed container image. Vellum will check availability again automatically.
system.serverReleaseCheckPreserved: The last confirmed release status remains valid.

system.serverReleaseCheckRateLimited: GitHub has temporarily limited further API requests. Vellum will wait until the limit resets and retry automatically.
system.serverReleaseCheckInvalid: GitHub returned an incomplete release response. Vellum discarded it and will retry automatically.
system.updaterOutdated: The update service is still on {current}; {available} is available.
system.updaterVersionUnknown: The update service does not report its version, so it predates version reporting and is out of date.
system.updaterBootstrapHint: This update service predates safe self-updates. Bootstrap it once in the stack directory; future updater releases install automatically:
system.updaterAutomaticHint: The update service will update itself automatically after the next healthy server update.
system.updaterAutomaticDisabledHint: Automatic updater updates are disabled. Set AUTO_UPDATE_UPDATER=true in the stack's .env file.
system.updaterSwapFailed: The update service could not replace itself. It is still running the previous version.
system.updaterSwapRolledBack: A self-update of the update service was rolled back; the previous version was restored.
system.phaseWaitingForHealth: Waiting for it to report healthy
system.serverConfirmSteps: Steps: verify the signature, back up the database, start the new version, wait for it to report healthy — and roll back automatically if it does not.
system.serverConfirmDowntime: At the end, the server restarts. This page briefly loses its connection and reconnects automatically.

provision.title: Provision over USB
provision.description: Push Wi-Fi and the server URL to a device over USB — no SoftAP setup.

provision.serverHint: Where the device reports in. Prefilled from this admin’s address.
provision.step1: Connect the display via USB-C and power it on.
provision.step2: Click “Connect” and choose its serial port once; the display restarts.
provision.step3: Select a detected Wi-Fi network or enter the SSID manually.
provision.step4: Click “Provision over USB”; the same connection stays open until setup finishes.

provisionExtras.successSummary: The display joined Wi-Fi and points at the server.
provisionExtras.preauthorizedSummary: It is pre-authorized and enrolls automatically on first contact.
provisionExtras.requirements: Requires Chrome/Edge 89+ with Web Serial support. Credentials travel over USB only.

provisionExtras.protectedDeviceDescription: This enrolled display requires a short-lived admin authorization. Vellum obtains it automatically when you provision.

provisionExtras.legacySecurityDescription: This firmware predates protected USB provisioning. Update it before deploying the display in a public location.
